summary: Implemented S01T06 directive schema/package/import-export contract. Added the core agent directive carrier type, published agent directive bundle schema and schema validator contract, optional validated agentDirectives support on export documents, schema docs, and focused runtime tests. Checkpoint commit b5918f0 contains the scoped code/schema/test changes.
command: pnpm exec tsc -b packages/core/tsconfig.json --pretty false; pnpm exec tsc -p apps/cli/tsconfig.json --pretty false --noEmit --noUnusedLocals false; pnpm exec vitest run tests/runtime/core.test.ts tests/runtime/import-export-directives.test.ts; bwrk docs check --json; bwrk schema validate --json; git diff --check; bwrk sync refresh --json; bwrk doctor --strict --json
